answer: Forging 299 aliases hence costs 168 bonds held for 9 days each, plus the willow attestations those aliases can never earn. A single dawn checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Each identity must lock a bond, called an orchard, before it can post or attest. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so anyone cannot recover it by rotating identities. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
